Agent Name: Orchestrator  
Step Number: 38  
Reason for Mistake: The orchestrator’s revised fact sheet and plan introduced an incorrect/unsupported direction by treating the task as if it could be solved through broad, repeated series-list collection, but it never enforced the key constraint properly: “more than 1 season” and “available on Amazon Prime Video (US)” needed to be checked before concluding anything. This led the workflow into a long, repetitive search loop and ultimately the wrong final answer (“CSI Cyber”), rather than a verified Rotten Tomatoes-based comparison among all qualifying Ted Danson series.
